t: You're on St Leonard's Terrace in Chelsea, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. From 1870 until 1882, this was the home of M. W. Hallett, who lived from 1825 to 1882. He's described as a London gentleman and a theatrical amateur, so someone who loved putting on plays for the pleasure of it rather than as a profession. He lived here for the last dozen or so years of his life.
